title: CommitInventory payload (command, topic inventory.commands)
description: The order completed: held stock leaves the system (reserved decreases, available unchanged). Idempotent: committing twice, or with no hold, is a no-op. Sent by Order on completion, and by Reconciliation when a completed order still holds stock (ADR 0009). Reply: InventoryCommitted.

reason.description: Optional, for logs and audit; set by Reconciliation's repairs.
